decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and infrastructure, so it can keep learning from usage and improving it through its own R&D.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflows, but recognition technology lies further from its messaging core, so some risk of refocusing remains.
Email-to-fax conversion draws on long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated customers who depend on fax, though fax demand is slowly declining.
This low-cost feature sits close to the established fax service, but it is likely to be folded into the base offering as fax use shrinks.

Multi-engine virus scanning extends the secure messaging core and can be run with existing knowledge, although the earlier withdrawal of the sandbox suggests the security portfolio may be consolidated.
